name: route-tabs
title: Route Tabs
description: Tabs whose panels are pages — a named nav of links drawn as the pill tabs, one URL per tab, with counts, an optimistic current tab and a pending bar while the next page loads, a panel that dims meanwhile, and a sideways-scrolling strip that keeps the current tab in view.

meta.whenToUse: A section's sub-pages as tabs in its layout, each tab its own URL (a space's Tasks/Library/Settings, Connections).
meta.whenNotToUse: Panels that swap in place without a URL (Tabs), or the app's main navigation (Sidebar).
